sentence: This project supports a conference on logic programming and nonmonotonic reasoning, which are foundational areas of AI.
This project studies dryland ecology, including plants, animals, and fungi, through independent research at a field station.
This project studies how living systems use signaling molecules to integrate signals and respond to wounding or infection.
This project studies how sea level rise changes the flow of water down tree trunks in coastal forests, from healthy forests to ghost forests.
This project builds an imaging tool that lets scientists watch free-swimming bacteria and biofilms in three dimensions at the single-cell level.
This project studies biological systems using imaging, computer modeling, and ideas from the physical sciences and engineering.
This project builds an alliance around hands-on learning at a semiconductor facility that makes integrated circuits.
This project studies how invasive plants change the water budget of a forest and tests whether removing them and replanting native species helps.
This project builds a remotely accessible laboratory where AI helps plan and improve the making of tiny electronic, photonic, and sensing devices.
This project creates teaching materials about auditing AI systems for risks, using hands-on labs with real-world datasets.
This project uses theory to study new phenomena that appear in quantum materials because of crystalline symmetry.
This project develops a network design that keeps wireless and wired connections in smart manufacturing systems reliable despite faults and interference.
This project develops ways to control complex systems directly from measured data instead of detailed mathematical models.
This project builds a 3D computer vision system that combines several kinds of sensors to understand off-road scenes.
This project builds a way to measure how the membrane voltage of hundreds of neurons changes at the same time.
This project builds a catheter-based method that makes customized medical implants inside the human body from granular hydrogels.
This project builds tools that let people edit and create 3D shapes using simple text, drawing on deep learning.
This project designs security architectures for computing systems that address software and hardware vulnerabilities together.
This project develops ways to keep deep-learning image reconstruction reliable when real-world data differ from the training data.
This project studies how micelles made from block copolymers fuse and break apart, and how they move toward more favorable states.
